summary: Function guidelines for modules: concise functions with descriptive underscore names and docstrings, follow DRY, and refactor deep nesting into functions.

answer_card.title: Function conventions
answer_card.answer_md: Keep functions concise with descriptive `snake_case` names and docstrings, follow DRY, and pull deeply nested loop bodies into functions.
